title: Convert N Models from RSM terms (if any) to expanded terms
modelselector1: Select one or more models to inspect if you have used any RSM terms (e.g., FO, TWI, SO, PQ) in the model formula. If so, convert the RSM terms to equivalent expanded standard formula terms (e.g., FO(A, B) => A + B and PQ(X,Y) => I(X^2) + I(Y^2) ). This conversion may be necessary, as many of the Model Evaluation analyses may not work if your model formula contains RSM terms.
outputModeNew: Save as new model(s) with a suffix
